description: A 2N2222 switches a 100 ohm load on 5 V with 1 kilohm in the base: fully on.
derivation: The base takes (5 - 0.7) / 1000 = 4.3 mA, so the gain of 100 allows 430 mA. The load needs only (5 - 0.2) / 100 = 48 mA, so the transistor saturates and the collector sits at the saturation voltage of 0.2 V.
